mapper.select:
INSERT INTO tags (id, user_id, name, created_at) VALUES
(#{tag.id}, #{userId}, #{tag.name}, #{tag.createdAt})
ON CONFLICT (user_id, lower(name)) DO UPDATE SET name = tags.name RETURNING id, user_id, name, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO save_tags (save_id, tag_id) VALUES (#{saveId}, #{tagId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT st.save_id, t.name FROM save_tags st JOIN tags t ON t.id = st.tag_id WHERE st.save_id IN #{saveId} ORDER BY lower(t.name)
SELECT t.name AS name, count(*) AS count FROM save_tags st JOIN tags t ON t.id = st.tag_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY t.id, t.name ORDER BY count(*) DESC, lower(t.name)
